## Example 1.2: Potential energy {.unnumbered .scrollable}

A reservoir sits 50 m above the turbines. Calculate the potential energy
available from 1000 kg of water.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: false


# Given
m = 1000   # mass of water (kg)
g = 9.81   # gravitational acceleration (m/s²)
z = 50     # height above turbines (m)

# Potential energy
E_p = m * g * z

print(f"E_p = m × g × z")
print(f"E_p = {m} × {g} × {z}")
print(f"E_p = {E_p:,.0f} J")
```
